headline_en: Sep 16 briefing · 4 new · loss $567K · enforcement $50K · 3 follow-ups
briefing_ko:
- **[Fake AI Trading Bot Drainer](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/fake-ai-trading-bots-are-getting-victims-to-build-their-own-drainers)** · Ethereum · 피싱 · **$517K** · 2.12 — 튜토리얼 따라 계약 배포·입금 시 컴파일러가 악성 바이트코드로 교체돼 ETH가 운영자에게 즉시 전송
- **[HEFU CHAI, HUAISONG XIANG](https://www.justice.gov/usao-sdny/pr/two-robinhood-employees-charged-fraud)** · 수사·기소 · **$50K** · 9.15 — 상품법 위반·전신 사기 혐의로 기소, 두 명이 법정에 섰다
- **소액·미상 2건** — [Bonfiretoken](https://x.com/SlowMist_Team/status/2100064586980528458) $50K, [Select Decks / Vin Phat](https://www.justice.gov/usao-ndwv/pr/northern-district-west-virginia-joins-doj-fraud-division-sba-and-sba-oig-surge) $245M (PPP 사기 단속 전체 규모 — 가상자산 관련 금액 미상)
- **후속 3건** — [custom Safe module](https://cointelegraph.com/news/mev-bot-intercepts-77m-in-rseth-from-ethereum-wallet-exploit) (첫 보도 9.15, Safe 모듈 rsETH 전송 시도, Yoink 봇이 앞서 7.7M…), [SpiralHookV2](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs/blob/main/src/test/2026-09/SpiralHookV2_exp.sol) (첫 보도 9.15, SPIRAL 펌프 후 여러 EOA가 tx.origin 대출, 10.7…), [Liquid Network](https://rekt.news/liquid-network-rekt) (첫 보도 9.15, 캐시 키 충돌로 L-BTC 생성, SideSwap으로 598.5 BTC…)
- **시사점** — DeFi 프로토콜의 가격·허가 검증 결함이 지속적으로 악용되고 있다계속반복.
briefing_en:
- **[Fake AI Trading Bot Drainer](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/fake-ai-trading-bots-are-getting-victims-to-build-their-own-drainers)** · Ethereum · Phishing · **$517K** · Feb 12 — victim followed tutorial, compiler swapped in malicious…
- **[HEFU CHAI, HUAISONG XIANG](https://www.justice.gov/usao-sdny/pr/two-robinhood-employees-charged-fraud)** · Enforcement · **$50K** · Sep 15 — charged with commodity law violation and wire fraud, both…
- **Smaller / unknown (2)** — [Bonfiretoken](https://x.com/SlowMist_Team/status/2100064586980528458) $50K, [Select Decks / Vin Phat](https://www.justice.gov/usao-ndwv/pr/northern-district-west-virginia-joins-doj-fraud-division-sba-and-sba-oig-surge) $245M (PPP 사기 단속 전체 규모 — 가상자산 관련 금액 미상)
- **Follow-ups (3)** — [custom Safe module](https://cointelegraph.com/news/mev-bot-intercepts-77m-in-rseth-from-ethereum-wallet-exploit) (first 9.15, attacker used Safe module to send rsETH, Yoink…), [SpiralHookV2](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs/blob/main/src/test/2026-09/SpiralHookV2_exp.sol) (first 9.15, attacker pumped SPIRAL price, multiple EOAs…), [Liquid Network](https://rekt.news/liquid-network-rekt) (first 9.15, cache key collision minted uncollateralized…)
- **Takeaway** — DeFi protocols suffer from price oracle and access-control flaws that attackers exploit to steal funds.
